name: ExplainMatch
description: Nina's read-only explain tool, since plan 04.11 part B stage 5 (שינוי לוגיקה – 11.2026) for the new receipts flow: for ONE bank line it explains the customer identification (the IdentifyCustomers cascade: customer, method, evidence, confidence 0–100 against identifyCertainAt → ודאי / לא ודאי / לא זוהה / אושר אוטומטית, or why the line is skipped) and the debt check against the customer's due months – the result stored on the approved receipt (debtCheckResult, months, the alert / task key), or a preview of what CheckDebt will decide once the receipt is approved (per-month balances and a Hebrew explanation; an empty OpenMovements mirror is reported). It no longer explains an invoice match – the stage-1 ladder is retired and the allocation to invoices is its own step. ALWAYS read-only, enforced in code: there is no dryRun input, identification runs as a dry run and the debt check is only read or previewed, so nothing is written to any table. Replaces the writing actions in Nina's tools because a code action cannot tell whether an agent or a person called it.

asOfDate.description: Clock for tests: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Asia/Jerusalem

identification.description: The line as IdentifyCustomers sees it: payerName, amount, valueDate, customerCode, customerName, confidence, identifyStatus, method, evidence, candidates[], receiptKey, taskKey, skippedReason

receipt.description: The line's Receipts row when it exists: receiptKey, receiptStatus, identifyStatus, identifyConfidence, matchStatus, debtCheckResult, debtCheckMonths, amount (null otherwise)

debtCheck.description: source (נשמר בקבלה / תחזית – יירשם אחרי אישור הקבלה), result, months[], matchStatus, taskKey, and for a preview balances[] {month, balance, cumulative, movements} + explanation, or error (null when the customer is unknown)

reasoning.description: Hebrew explanation: identification, then the debt check
